name: Edible Resource Recognition
mechanism: Distinguish locally known food resources through transmitted observations and verified identification
operating_requirement: Competent local knowledge, actual accessible resources and careful handling
consequence: Expand recognized food opportunities without treating unknown organisms as safe

name: Wild Food Harvest Rotation
mechanism: Rotate gathering effort according to observed renewal and depletion of local food patches
operating_requirement: Accessible patches, repeated observation and coordinated gatherers
consequence: Reduce some local overharvest while finite seasonal yields remain

name: Digging Stick Harvesting
mechanism: Use a shaped tool to recover selected underground foods with controlled soil disturbance
operating_requirement: Suitable tools, recognized food plants and human effort
consequence: Access specific resources while breakage and regrowth constrain repeated harvest

name: Food Pounding Mortars
mechanism: Break or separate suitable food material through controlled impact in a fitted receptacle
operating_requirement: Compatible pounding tools, actual food and labor
consequence: Prepare selected foods with finite work and tool wear

name: Hearth Roasting Control
mechanism: Manage distance and exposure of suitable food to a controlled hearth
operating_requirement: Fuel, maintained hearth, suitable food and attentive cooks
consequence: Prepare evaluated roasted foods while fuel and uneven heat limit output

name: Earth Oven Cooking
mechanism: Retain and transfer heat through an enclosed heated-earth or stone cooking arrangement
operating_requirement: Suitable site and materials, fuel, food and practiced operators
consequence: Cook suitable batches with retained heat and finite preparation time

name: Food Steaming Vessels
mechanism: Transfer heat to food through a qualified steam-producing vessel arrangement
operating_requirement: Compatible vessels, clean water, fuel and careful operation
consequence: Prepare selected foods without assuming one heating method suits all products

name: Cereal Dehulling
mechanism: Separate protective grain coverings while limiting loss of edible material
operating_requirement: Suitable grain, mechanical tools and practiced separation
consequence: Recover an edible fraction while accounting for hulls and broken grain

name: Starch Washing Separation
mechanism: Separate suitable starch-rich fractions by controlled washing and settling
operating_requirement: Recognized feedstock, suitable water, vessels and labor
consequence: Produce evaluated starch ingredients with water use and residue losses

name: Alkaline Grain Processing
mechanism: Apply an established food-compatible alkaline process to suitable grain with controlled washing
operating_requirement: Qualified food-grade inputs, suitable vessels, water and trained preparation
consequence: Change selected grain processing and nutritional properties within validated product limits

name: Hand Dough Forming
mechanism: Shape a prepared dough through repeated hand or simple-tool work
operating_requirement: Suitable ingredients, working surface and skilled labor
consequence: Produce consistent forms for compatible cooking processes

name: Managed Bee Hives
mechanism: Maintain suitable bee colonies in accessible constructed nesting spaces
operating_requirement: Appropriate bees, forage, hive materials and practiced care
consequence: Obtain finite colony products while colony survival and forage limit yield

name: Movable Comb Frames
mechanism: Support removable comb structures that permit qualified colony inspection and product handling
operating_requirement: Compatible hive design, fitted frames and trained beekeepers
consequence: Inspect and harvest selected colonies with less structural disturbance

name: Bee Colony Health Observation
mechanism: Track colony behavior, brood condition and population changes against seasonal context
operating_requirement: Repeated inspections, competent interpretation and suitable management resources
consequence: Identify concerning changes without diagnosing every cause from one observation

name: Managed Pollination Contracts
mechanism: Coordinate suitable pollinator service with crop flowering and colony requirements
operating_requirement: Healthy compatible colonies, flowering crops, actual transport and negotiated service
consequence: Support pollination-dependent crop production without benefiting every crop equally

name: Honey Extraction Separation
mechanism: Separate and handle qualified hive products while preserving identity and quality
operating_requirement: Suitable extraction equipment, clean containers and beekeeping labor
consequence: Recover usable honey with handling and storage limits

name: Fish Net Mesh Design
mechanism: Construct and select meshes against target catch and observed escape characteristics
operating_requirement: Suitable fibers, net-making skill, accessible fish stocks and maintenance
consequence: Catch a bounded size range while bycatch and stock effects remain

name: Fish Trap Flow Siting
mechanism: Place retrievable traps using observed fish movement and local water flow
operating_requirement: Suitable traps, permitted access, actual stocks and checking labor
consequence: Obtain finite catches with ecological and animal-welfare consequences

name: Shellfish Harvest Area Assessment
mechanism: Assess harvest-area conditions against qualified contamination and closure evidence
operating_requirement: Reliable local observations, appropriate monitoring and accountable harvest decisions
consequence: Restrict unsafe harvest rather than assuming appearance establishes edibility

name: Ice Chilling Foods
mechanism: Transfer heat from suitable food into melting ice through a controlled chilled handling arrangement
operating_requirement: Actual suitable ice, compatible clean containers, drainage, handling labor and validated product conditions
consequence: Slow selected food deterioration while consuming finite ice and retaining time-temperature limits

name: Shellfish Aquaculture Substrates
mechanism: Provide suitable settlement and growing structures for evaluated shellfish cultivation
operating_requirement: Appropriate seed stocks, water conditions, farm structures and husbandry
consequence: Grow finite shellfish biomass while disease and site carrying capacity remain

name: Seaweed Farm Cultivation
mechanism: Establish and manage suitable seaweed growth on qualified farm structures
operating_requirement: Appropriate propagules, water conditions, access and farm labor
consequence: Harvest finite algal biomass without assuming all species are edible or ecologically suitable

name: Fish Stock Catch Assessment
mechanism: Relate observed catches and sampling to uncertain stock change and harvest effort
operating_requirement: Catch records, representative monitoring and analytical labor
consequence: Guide bounded harvest decisions without guaranteeing exact stock abundance

name: Animal Handling Enclosures
mechanism: Organize accessible barriers and handling spaces matched to animal behavior
operating_requirement: Suitable materials, space, trained handlers and actual animals
consequence: Improve controlled handling while crowding and welfare constrain use

name: Livestock Body Condition Scoring
mechanism: Compare species-appropriate condition observations using a repeatable assessment scale
operating_requirement: Trained observers, repeated access and feeding or care options
consequence: Identify changing nutritional condition without equating size with health

name: Livestock Birth Support
mechanism: Observe birth-related needs and provide qualified assistance or referral
operating_requirement: Competent animal carers, suitable space and veterinary access where available
consequence: Support viable births without guaranteed offspring or survival

name: Veterinary Case Records
mechanism: Retain animal identity and longitudinal care observations for clinical review
operating_requirement: Identified animals, trained carers and usable records
consequence: Support continuity of animal care rather than automatic disease protection

name: Herd Quarantine Practice
mechanism: Separate and observe incoming or affected animals through a qualified health protocol
operating_requirement: Suitable separate space, staff, feed, water and veterinary evidence
consequence: Reduce selected disease introduction risks while isolation consumes real capacity

name: Livestock Parasite Monitoring
mechanism: Use qualified observations or tests to assess relevant parasite burdens
operating_requirement: Competent animal-health staff, suitable diagnostics and records
consequence: Guide indicated management without routine universal treatment bonuses

name: Animal Feed Storage Hygiene
mechanism: Maintain feed quality through controlled handling, exclusion and condition checks
operating_requirement: Suitable feed stores, actual stocks, monitoring and cleaning labor
consequence: Reduce avoidable contamination and loss while feed remains finite

name: Feed Digestibility Trials
mechanism: Compare usable nutritional contribution of defined feed under controlled evidence
operating_requirement: Qualified trial design, animal care, characterized feeds and measurements
consequence: Improve feed evaluation without treating laboratory composition as complete utilization

name: Pasture Forage Budgeting
mechanism: Match planned grazing demand to measured forage growth and accessible reserves
operating_requirement: Pasture observations, actual herd demand and controllable access
consequence: Reduce grazing shortfalls without creating forage from a schedule

name: Livestock Heat Stress Management
mechanism: Identify heat exposure and apply qualified shade, ventilation or water support
operating_requirement: Appropriate shelters, actual water, labor and species-specific observations
consequence: Reduce selected heat-related losses within resource and environmental limits

name: Milking Machine Qualification
mechanism: Qualify controlled mechanical milk extraction and hygienic equipment handling
operating_requirement: Compatible machines, power, cleaning supplies and trained herd care
consequence: Collect milk with finite equipment throughput and animal-health constraints

name: Milk Pasteurization Control
mechanism: Apply and verify a product-specific evaluated heat process to milk
operating_requirement: Qualified heating and cooling equipment, measurements and hygienic handling
consequence: Reduce specified hazards while preventing post-process recontamination remains necessary

name: Milk Homogenization
mechanism: Alter fat-droplet distribution through qualified mechanical processing
operating_requirement: Compatible equipment, power and hygienic product handling
consequence: Change physical milk stability without independently providing microbial safety

name: Fermentation Starter Cultures
mechanism: Maintain and use characterized cultures for a specified food fermentation
operating_requirement: Qualified cultures, suitable substrate, hygiene and controlled process conditions
consequence: Improve reproducibility while contamination and culture drift remain

name: Food Water Activity Measurement
mechanism: Measure available water in a defined food matrix against a validated method
operating_requirement: Qualified instrument, representative samples and competent interpretation
consequence: Support product-specific stability assessment without substituting for all hazard controls

name: Food Acidity Measurement
mechanism: Measure a specified acidity property with calibrated food-analysis methods
operating_requirement: Qualified testing, representative samples and retained process context
consequence: Inform product assessment without assuming acidity alone establishes safety

name: Food Freeze Concentration
mechanism: Separate ice from suitable liquids to concentrate retained constituents
operating_requirement: Qualified freezing and separation equipment, power and hygiene
consequence: Concentrate selected products while separation losses and energy costs remain

name: Vacuum Food Evaporation
mechanism: Remove water from suitable foods under controlled reduced-pressure conditions
operating_requirement: Qualified vessels, vacuum, heating, cooling and process monitoring
consequence: Concentrate selected foods within thermal-damage and energy limits

name: Spray Food Drying
mechanism: Dry dispersed food droplets through a qualified heat-and-mass-transfer process
operating_requirement: Food-compatible atomization, air handling, energy and powder collection
consequence: Produce suitable powders with finite throughput and contamination controls

name: Food Extrusion Cooking
mechanism: Combine mechanical working and controlled heat in a qualified continuous food-forming process
operating_requirement: Food-compatible extruder, actual ingredients, power and process monitoring
consequence: Produce selected textures and shapes with equipment and formulation limits

name: Food Emulsion Stabilization
mechanism: Maintain evaluated mixtures of otherwise separating food phases through suitable formulation and processing
operating_requirement: Qualified ingredients, mixing equipment and stability testing
consequence: Produce specified emulsified foods without unlimited shelf life

name: Food Package Barrier Testing
mechanism: Measure package transmission and compatibility against a specified food-storage requirement
operating_requirement: Representative packages, qualified tests and product evidence
consequence: Select suitable packaging while real sealing and handling remain necessary

name: Aseptic Food Filling
mechanism: Keep qualified processed food and packaging protected during a validated filling operation
operating_requirement: Appropriate plant, validated processes, hygiene controls and trained operators
consequence: Package specified foods with finite throughput and verified process limits

name: Food Package Leak Detection
mechanism: Test finished package integrity through a qualified non-destructive or sampling method
operating_requirement: Suitable inspection equipment, samples and rejection controls
consequence: Find supported seal defects without certifying every possible contamination hazard

name: Fresh Produce Ripening Control
mechanism: Manage measured storage atmosphere and conditions for a specific ripening behavior
operating_requirement: Suitable produce, qualified rooms, sensors and operating staff
consequence: Schedule selected quality changes while losses and species differences remain

name: Food Allergen Segregation
mechanism: Separate and verify relevant allergen handling across a food-production process
operating_requirement: Accurate ingredient information, dedicated or validated cleaned equipment and trained staff
consequence: Reduce specified cross-contact risk without treating labels as physical separation

name: Food Contaminant Sampling Plans
mechanism: Choose representative sampling and acceptance rules for specified contamination questions
operating_requirement: Validated tests, representative samples and accountable release decisions
consequence: Bound evidence on lots while acknowledging undetected hazards and sampling uncertainty

name: Food Recall Traceback
mechanism: Identify affected product movements and coordinate removal or correction against verified evidence
operating_requirement: Maintained lot records, reachable recipients and actual retrieval capacity
consequence: Limit continued exposure while untraceable stock remains uncertain

name: Postharvest Loss Measurement
mechanism: Measure quantity and quality losses across defined handling stages with explicit boundaries
operating_requirement: Representative observation, scales, condition assessment and records
consequence: Target avoidable losses without counting moisture change as all lost food

name: Crop Yield Mapping
mechanism: Associate calibrated harvest measurements with position and field conditions
operating_requirement: Suitable harvest sensors, positioning, actual harvested crop and data review
consequence: Reveal spatial yield variation without diagnosing its cause automatically

name: Variable Rate Crop Inputs
mechanism: Apply qualified crop inputs at spatially differentiated rates based on measured evidence
operating_requirement: Compatible application equipment, actual inputs and locally validated plans
consequence: Adjust resource use while response uncertainty and soil constraints remain

name: Microbial Food Protein Qualification
mechanism: Evaluate harvested microbial biomass as a specified food ingredient
operating_requirement: Qualified organism, feedstock, process containment, purification and food-safety evidence
consequence: Supply evaluated protein-containing biomass with finite energy and substrate requirements

name: Precision Fermented Food Ingredients
mechanism: Produce and qualify a specified food ingredient through a characterized fermentation process
operating_requirement: Suitable production strain, feedstock, plant, purification and release testing
consequence: Supply a defined ingredient without making a complete diet from a fermenter

name: Cultured Food Cell Expansion
mechanism: Expand qualified food-production cells under evaluated culture and harvest conditions
operating_requirement: Suitable cell source, culture inputs, controlled plant and food qualification
consequence: Produce limited cell biomass without assuming low cost or complete meat equivalence

name: Cultured Food Structure Formation
mechanism: Organize qualified food-cell biomass into an evaluated edible structure
operating_requirement: Food-compatible supports, cells, nutrients, process equipment and product testing
consequence: Investigate desired food texture and composition with uncertain scale and affordability
